subject.title: fix(plugins): clone registration record metadata for transactional rollback isolation

question: Which open branch should be the canonical repair for plugin-registration rollback isolation: this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108143?
rationale: Both branches target the same failure mode and both present positive proof, but they differ in currentness and test shape; choosing the permanent snapshot contract is an ownership decision rather than a mechanical contributor follow-up.

options.title: Adopt this PR
options.body: Use this newer branch as the canonical repair after confirming its targeted cloning contract covers the loader scenario exercised by the competing branch.

options.title: Adopt the competing PR
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108143 if its production-loader proof and narrower implementation better express the intended transaction contract.

options.title: Request consolidation
options.body: Ask the two contributors to consolidate the chosen implementation and tests into one branch before merge.

recommendation.title: Adopt this PR
recommendation.body: Use this newer branch as the canonical repair after confirming its targeted cloning contract covers the loader scenario exercised by the competing branch.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history attributes the centralized rollback boundary to this contributor.
